rationale: Maximum-quality reference contract. correctness=5: PK + 2 FKs + 3 enums + min constraints + nullability + sensible types. completeness=5: owner + on-call + SLA + retention (by stream including 2555-day data retention) + cadence + consumes[]. security=5: classified PII (policy_number, claimant_name) with explicit masking algorithms + scopes; hipaaApplicable flag set. governance=5: actuarial team + on-call rotation + classification + retention; HIPAA-applicable marker. performance=5: clustering on (policy_number, filed_date) — both join keys and time partition. documentation=5: product-level description + per-column descriptions with semantic detail (e.g. 'paid_amount_cents: 0 if denied or still open').
